summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the new treatment-first quiz routing. All features working correctly: city selection shown first on all quiz pages (/orthodontics/quiz, /implants/quiz, /cosmetic-dentistry/quiz, /tmj/quiz, /sleep-airway/quiz), three city options (Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna) available, city indicator displayed during quiz with 'Промени' (Change) button, quiz questions flow correctly (5 questions), quiz results show correct city-specific page links (e.g., /plovdiv/orthodontics), change city button returns to city selection, treatment page buttons link to correct /treatment/quiz routes (no old /sofia/treatment/quiz links), lead submission works with correct city_slug included.
